high_level_description: This image captures a serene coastal scene at what appears to be either dawn or dusk, given the soft lighting and the position of the sun near the horizon. The sky is filled with a mix of clouds, some illuminated by the sunlight, creating a dramatic and picturesque backdrop. The clouds range from light to dark shades of blue and gray, with hints of orange and pink near the horizon, suggesting the time could be early morning or late evening. The ocean is calm, with gentle waves lapping onto a pebble beach. The foam created by the waves is white and frothy, adding texture to the foreground.
